diagram_previews.alt: A frustum of a cone in oblique view: the bottom base has radius 4 (back half of its rim dashed), the top base has radius 2, and the slant height is 3. Point A is at the front of the bottom rim and point B at the back of the top rim.

The lateral surface unrolled: a sector of an annulus with inner radius 3 and outer radius 6 about the apex O, spanning 240 degrees. A lies on the inner arc and B on the outer arc, 120 degrees apart. The gray dashed straight segment AB dips inside the inner circle; the red shortest path runs from B along the tangent to the inner circle at T (right angle at T, radius OT = 3) and then along the inner arc from T to A. OB = 6 is dashed.
